changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.28
changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key answers one of 256 striped keys in one namespace instead of one key per tuple: the same md5 of the length-prefixed five parts, its low 8 bits the stripe, its high 56 bits fixed. Same signature, IMMUTABLE, PARALLEL SAFE, SECURITY INVOKER, grants unchanged; the catalog-051-2 triggers pick it up as they are. No data effect.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key(p_tenant text, p_content_type text, p_owner_id text, p_embedding_model text, p_model_version text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT (('x' || left(md5('16:catalog_tuple_lock'), 16))::bit(64)::bigint & (-256)::bigint) | (('x' || left(md5( '13:catalog_tuple' || length(coalesce(p_tenant, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_tenant, '') || length(coalesce(p_content_type, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_content_type, '') || length(coalesce(p_owner_id, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_owner_id, '') || length(coalesce(p_embedding_model, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_embedding_model, '') || length(coalesce(p_model_version, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_model_version, '') ), 16))::bit(64)::bigint & 255::bigint) $fn$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key(p_tenant text, p_content_type text, p_owner_id text, p_embedding_model text, p_model_version text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT ('x' || left(md5( '13:catalog_tuple' || length(coalesce(p_tenant, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_tenant, '') || length(coalesce(p_content_type, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_content_type, '') || length(coalesce(p_owner_id, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_owner_id, '') || length(coalesce(p_embedding_model, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_embedding_model, '') || length(coalesce(p_model_version, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_model_version, '') ), 16))::bit(64)::bigint $fn$;
